extraction_notes: The PDF is image-only; values were manually transcribed from the Electrical Characteristics table and digitized from the usable Typical Characteristics plots.
Printed page 1 is PDF p. 2 and printed page 2 is PDF p. 3; references preserve both PDF and printed numbering.
Curve points are direct visual digitizations of plotted lines and are not interpolated between unobserved data; plot-only hFE curves do not state VCE and therefore are not duplicated in gain_points.
The electrical table provides no Cibo row; cibo is null while the plotted Cib curve is retained.
No datasheet revision identifier is printed; the revision field records that omission and the PDF creation date.
